title: Phoenix turns shipping containers into 40 tiny homes for homeless seniors in a $750,000 project; 56 permanent units next
summary_full: In a groundbreaking move, Phoenix has established a new transitional housing community tailored for older adults in need. Utilizing repurposed shipping containers, the first phase hosts forty individual units that come with essential amenities and supportive services. The upcoming second phase will enhance the offering with fifty-six affordable permanent apartments, seeking to ensure a stable living environment for at-risk senior citizens.
